name: Place a litter tray away from food and sleep
description: Put the tray in a quiet place, not beside the food, water, or bed.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Place a litter tray away from food and sleep.

levels.name: Find a quiet corner
levels.completion_criterion: Choose a spot that is not a busy corridor or a noisy room, and put the empty tray there.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not punish the cat. If toileting outside the tray becomes regular, talk to a vet rather than inventing a treatment.

levels.name: Separate the resources
levels.completion_criterion: Move the food and water so they are not next to the tray, and keep the bed elsewhere.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not punish the cat. If toileting outside the tray becomes regular, talk to a vet rather than inventing a treatment.

levels.name: Leave the cat undisturbed
levels.completion_criterion: Once the cat uses it, do not stand over them or move the tray mid-use.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not punish the cat. If toileting outside the tray becomes regular, talk to a vet rather than inventing a treatment.

safety_notes: Do not punish the cat. If toileting outside the tray becomes regular, talk to a vet rather than inventing a treatment.

name: Replace the litter on a weekly rhythm
description: Spot-clean the tray each day you use it, and replace the litter at least once in the week.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Replace the litter on a weekly rhythm.

levels.name: Scoop today
levels.completion_criterion: Remove the soiled clumps today and leave enough litter for the cat to dig.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not use a strong scent or an air freshener in the tray. Do not mix cleaners.

levels.name: Mark the change day
levels.completion_criterion: Write the day you will empty and replace the litter, within seven days of the last full change.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not use a strong scent or an air freshener in the tray. Do not mix cleaners.

levels.name: Replace it
levels.completion_criterion: Empty the tray on that day, wash it with a product that is safe for cats, and put fresh litter back.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not use a strong scent or an air freshener in the tray. Do not mix cleaners.

safety_notes: Do not use a strong scent or an air freshener in the tray. Do not mix cleaners.

name: Change litter type gradually
description: If you switch litter, mix the new type in over about a week, or offer it in a second tray.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Change litter type gradually.

levels.name: Keep the old litter
levels.completion_criterion: Leave the litter the cat already uses in the current tray.
levels.safety_requirements: Stop the change if the cat stops using the tray, and do not punish them.

levels.name: Add a little new litter
levels.completion_criterion: Mix a small amount of the new litter into the old, or put the new litter in a second tray beside it.
levels.safety_requirements: Stop the change if the cat stops using the tray, and do not punish them.

levels.name: Let the cat choose
levels.completion_criterion: Over the next days, increase the new litter only if the cat is still using a tray.
levels.safety_requirements: Stop the change if the cat stops using the tray, and do not punish them.

safety_notes: Stop the change if the cat stops using the tray, and do not punish them.

name: Provide one tray per cat and a spare
description: Count the cats and set out one tray each, plus one extra.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Provide one tray per cat and a spare.

levels.name: Count the cats
levels.completion_criterion: Count the cats who share the home.
levels.safety_requirements: Trays should be sturdy and non-toxic. This is not a medical check.

levels.name: Set the trays out
levels.completion_criterion: Put down one more tray than that count, in more than one quiet place if you can.
levels.safety_requirements: Trays should be sturdy and non-toxic. This is not a medical check.

levels.name: Check they can all turn
levels.completion_criterion: Look at each tray and say whether a cat can step in and turn.
levels.safety_requirements: Trays should be sturdy and non-toxic. This is not a medical check.

safety_notes: Trays should be sturdy and non-toxic. This is not a medical check.

name: Clean a toileting accident without punishing the cat
description: Wash the spot and do not punish the cat. If accidents are regular, the next step is a vet, not a punishment.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Clean a toileting accident without punishing the cat.

levels.name: Do not punish
levels.completion_criterion: When you find the accident, do not shout or push the cat toward it.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not mix cleaning products. Do not diagnose a disease.

levels.name: Wash the smell
levels.completion_criterion: Wash the area with a biological or enzymatic wash made for this, and let it dry.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not mix cleaning products. Do not diagnose a disease.

levels.name: Decide the next step
levels.completion_criterion: If this keeps happening, write that you will ask a vet, and stop there.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not mix cleaning products. Do not diagnose a disease.

safety_notes: Do not mix cleaning products. Do not diagnose a disease.

name: Leave enough litter to dig and cover
description: Put in a layer the cat can dig and use to cover, rather than a thin scatter.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Leave enough litter to dig and cover.

levels.name: Look at the depth
levels.completion_criterion: Look at the tray and say whether a paw could dig.
levels.safety_requirements: Some cats prefer shallower litter. If they avoid a deep tray, offer a second depth rather than forcing one.

levels.name: Add litter
levels.completion_criterion: Add litter until the layer is deep enough to cover waste, without filling the tray to the rim.
levels.safety_requirements: Some cats prefer shallower litter. If they avoid a deep tray, offer a second depth rather than forcing one.

levels.name: Watch one use
levels.completion_criterion: If you can do so without disturbing the cat, see whether they can turn and cover.
levels.safety_requirements: Some cats prefer shallower litter. If they avoid a deep tray, offer a second depth rather than forcing one.

safety_notes: Some cats prefer shallower litter. If they avoid a deep tray, offer a second depth rather than forcing one.

name: Give each cat a hide of their own
description: In a home with more than one cat, each cat has a place to get out of sight.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Give each cat a hide of their own.

levels.name: Count hides and cats
levels.completion_criterion: Count the enclosed rests and the cats.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not shut a cat inside a hide. An entrance and a way out both stay open.

levels.name: Add the missing hide
levels.completion_criterion: Add a box or bed with a way in until there is at least one per cat.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not shut a cat inside a hide. An entrance and a way out both stay open.

levels.name: Put one somewhere quiet
levels.completion_criterion: Move one hide off the main path so a cat can leave the others.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not shut a cat inside a hide. An entrance and a way out both stay open.

safety_notes: Do not shut a cat inside a hide. An entrance and a way out both stay open.

name: Offer a high rest a cat can get onto safely
description: Give a raised place large enough to lie on, that the cat can reach and leave without a fall.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Offer a high rest a cat can get onto safely.

levels.name: Choose the place
levels.completion_criterion: Pick a shelf, a wardrobe top, or a cat tree the cat can reach.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not put a rest where a jump would land on a cooker or a drop the cat cannot manage.

levels.name: Check the landing
levels.completion_criterion: Put a steady step or choose a height the cat already uses, and move breakable things off the edge.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not put a rest where a jump would land on a cooker or a drop the cat cannot manage.

levels.name: Watch one climb
levels.completion_criterion: See the cat go up and down once, and take the rest away if it wobbles.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not put a rest where a jump would land on a cooker or a drop the cat cannot manage.

safety_notes: Do not put a rest where a jump would land on a cooker or a drop the cat cannot manage.

name: Leave the carrier out as an ordinary bed
description: Leave the carrier in a place the cat already likes, with something that smells of home inside it.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Leave the carrier out as an ordinary bed.

levels.name: Open it in a liked spot
levels.completion_criterion: Leave the carrier open where the cat already sits, not only on travel days.
levels.can_do: Open it in a liked spot
levels.safety_requirements: Never shout or force the cat into the carrier as training. Clicker work is a later skill.

levels.name: Add a familiar cloth
levels.completion_criterion: Put a piece of their bedding inside and leave the door open.
levels.safety_requirements: Never shout or force the cat into the carrier as training. Clicker work is a later skill.

levels.name: Reward a voluntary visit
levels.completion_criterion: If the cat steps in, give a treat and stop. Do not push them in.
levels.safety_requirements: Never shout or force the cat into the carrier as training. Clicker work is a later skill.

safety_notes: Never shout or force the cat into the carrier as training. Clicker work is a later skill.

name: Settle a cat indoors after a move
description: Keep the cat inside after a house move, then use short supervised trips outside before any free roaming.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Settle a cat indoors after a move.

levels.name: Keep them in
levels.completion_criterion: For the first fortnight, keep the cat indoors and show them the tray, water, and a hide.
levels.safety_requirements: The page describes about two to three weeks indoors. Do not let the cat out to look for the old home. A road is not this practice.

levels.name: Supervise one outing
levels.completion_criterion: When their behaviour has settled, go out with them for a short time, not at dawn or dusk.
levels.safety_requirements: The page describes about two to three weeks indoors. Do not let the cat out to look for the old home. A road is not this practice.

levels.name: Call them in
levels.completion_criterion: Call them back with food, and end the outing while they are still near you.
levels.safety_requirements: The page describes about two to three weeks indoors. Do not let the cat out to look for the old home. A road is not this practice.

safety_notes: The page describes about two to three weeks indoors. Do not let the cat out to look for the old home. A road is not this practice.

name: Call a cat in with a treat cue
description: Shake a treat pot, say one short cue, and reward the cat when they come in.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Call a cat in with a treat cue.

levels.name: Pair the sound
levels.completion_criterion: Shake the pot indoors, say the cue, and give a treat when the cat arrives.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a treat the cat may have. Do not chase them into a road.

levels.name: Use it at the door
levels.completion_criterion: At the end of a supervised outing, shake the pot and say the same cue.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a treat the cat may have. Do not chase them into a road.

levels.name: Reward the return
levels.completion_criterion: Give the treat when they are inside, and close the outing.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a treat the cat may have. Do not chase them into a road.

safety_notes: Use a treat the cat may have. Do not chase them into a road.

name: Set out play for an indoor cat
description: An indoor cat needs more to do. Put out a toy and a space to climb, then play and stop.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Set out play for an indoor cat.

levels.name: Clear a run
levels.completion_criterion: Clear a short path the cat can run without meeting a hazard.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not use your hands as the prey. Stop if the cat becomes frightened.

levels.name: Offer one toy
levels.completion_criterion: Bring out one toy and play until the cat loses interest.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not use your hands as the prey. Stop if the cat becomes frightened.

levels.name: Put the toy away
levels.completion_criterion: End the game and leave a scratching post or a climb still available.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not use your hands as the prey. Stop if the cat becomes frightened.

safety_notes: Do not use your hands as the prey. Stop if the cat becomes frightened.

name: Name the pressure in a suspicious message
description: Before you click, name which pressure the message uses: authority, urgency, emotion, scarcity, or a news hook.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Name the pressure in a suspicious message.

levels.name: Stop contact
levels.completion_criterion: Do not tap the link. Put the phone or the mouse down.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not reply with a code, a password, or a card number. Spelling mistakes are no longer a reliable test.

levels.name: Name the sign
levels.completion_criterion: Say which of those five signs you can see, or say you cannot see one.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not reply with a code, a password, or a card number. Spelling mistakes are no longer a reliable test.

levels.name: Leave it unopened
levels.completion_criterion: Leave the link and the attachment untouched.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not reply with a code, a password, or a card number. Spelling mistakes are no longer a reliable test.

safety_notes: Do not reply with a code, a password, or a card number. Spelling mistakes are no longer a reliable test.

name: Check a caller using a number you already trust
description: If a call or message claims to be your bank or another official body, contact them on a number from their site or a statement, not from the message.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Check a caller using a number you already trust.

levels.name: Break off
levels.completion_criterion: End the call or close the message without giving a detail.
levels.safety_requirements: A bank will not ask you to confirm account details by email or on an inbound call. Do not read out a code.

levels.name: Find a number you trust
levels.completion_criterion: Use the number on your card, a paper statement, or the organisation's own website.
levels.safety_requirements: A bank will not ask you to confirm account details by email or on an inbound call. Do not read out a code.

levels.name: Ask them yourself
levels.completion_criterion: Call that number and ask whether they were trying to reach you.
levels.safety_requirements: A bank will not ask you to confirm account details by email or on an inbound call. Do not read out a code.

safety_notes: A bank will not ask you to confirm account details by email or on an inbound call. Do not read out a code.

name: Forward a suspicious email without clicking
description: Forward the email to report@phishing.gov.uk and do not open its links. Junk you already left in spam need not be forwarded.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Forward a suspicious email without clicking.

levels.name: Do not click
levels.completion_criterion: Leave every link and attachment closed.
levels.safety_requirements: This reports a suspicious message. It does not report a crime or a loss of money.

levels.name: Forward it
levels.completion_criterion: Forward the message to report@phishing.gov.uk.
levels.safety_requirements: This reports a suspicious message. It does not report a crime or a loss of money.

levels.name: Stop if it bounces once
levels.completion_criterion: If a one-link email is rejected as already-known spam, do not keep resending it.
levels.safety_requirements: This reports a suspicious message. It does not report a crime or a loss of money.

safety_notes: This reports a suspicious message. It does not report a crime or a loss of money.

name: Choose the right place to report a scam
description: A suspicious email goes to the NCSC. Money already lost, in England, Wales, or Northern Ireland, goes to Report Fraud or the bank.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Choose the right place to report a scam.

levels.name: Say what happened
levels.completion_criterion: Say whether you only received a message, or whether money or an account has already gone.
levels.safety_requirements: In Scotland the police route is 101, as the page states. Do not publish account numbers in the practice note.

levels.name: Pick the route
levels.completion_criterion: If it is only a suspicious email, use report@phishing.gov.uk. If money is gone, contact the bank and Report Fraud.
levels.safety_requirements: In Scotland the police route is 101, as the page states. Do not publish account numbers in the practice note.

levels.name: Do not use the email route for a crime
levels.completion_criterion: Do not send a fraud report only to the phishing address.
levels.can_do: Do not use the email route for a crime
levels.safety_requirements: In Scotland the police route is 101, as the page states. Do not publish account numbers in the practice note.

safety_notes: In Scotland the police route is 101, as the page states. Do not publish account numbers in the practice note.

name: Leave a QR code in an email unscanned
description: A QR code in an email is a link. Do not scan it. A code on a menu in front of you is a different situation.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Leave a QR code in an email unscanned.

levels.name: Notice the code
levels.completion_criterion: Point to the QR code in the message and do not open the camera on it.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not scan the code to see where it goes.

levels.name: Say why
levels.completion_criterion: Say that this code is inside a message you did not trust, so you will not scan it.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not scan the code to see where it goes.

levels.name: Use another route
levels.completion_criterion: If you still need the organisation, go to the site you already know, not through the code.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not scan the code to see where it goes.

safety_notes: Do not scan the code to see where it goes.

name: Review one public detail a scam could copy
description: Look at one thing your profile shows and decide whether a stranger needs to see it.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Review one public detail a scam could copy.

levels.name: Open the profile
levels.completion_criterion: Open a social profile you control.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not change someone else's account. Reviewing settings is not the same as turning on two-step verification.

levels.name: Pick one detail
levels.completion_criterion: Point to one detail, such as a birthday, a pet's name, or a workplace.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not change someone else's account. Reviewing settings is not the same as turning on two-step verification.

levels.name: Change or keep it
levels.completion_criterion: Hide it or leave it, and say which you chose.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not change someone else's account. Reviewing settings is not the same as turning on two-step verification.

safety_notes: Do not change someone else's account. Reviewing settings is not the same as turning on two-step verification.

name: Scribble outward from the middle of an object
description: Start in the middle of something you can see and scribble outward until the overall shape appears. Finish in under two minutes.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Scribble outward from the middle of an object.

levels.name: Set the object
levels.completion_criterion: Put one object where you can see it, and start the pencil in the middle of the page.
levels.safety_requirements: Draw from an object you may look at. Do not trace a copyrighted picture.

levels.name: Move outward
levels.completion_criterion: Use circular marks that grow outward until the outer shape is there.
levels.safety_requirements: Draw from an object you may look at. Do not trace a copyrighted picture.

levels.name: Stop on time
levels.completion_criterion: Stop before two minutes and leave the scribble, even if details are missing.
levels.safety_requirements: Draw from an object you may look at. Do not trace a copyrighted picture.

safety_notes: Draw from an object you may look at. Do not trace a copyrighted picture.

name: Gesture-draw an object in one minute
description: Keep the pencil on the paper and use longer strokes, not circles, to catch the whole shape in under a minute.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Gesture-draw an object in one minute.

levels.name: Keep the pencil down
levels.completion_criterion: Put the pencil on the paper and do not lift it for the first pass.
levels.safety_requirements: This is a fast study, not a finished portrait. Use an object or a person who agreed to sit.

levels.name: Use long strokes
levels.completion_criterion: Follow the long directions of the object rather than circling in place.
levels.safety_requirements: This is a fast study, not a finished portrait. Use an object or a person who agreed to sit.

levels.name: Stop at a minute
levels.completion_criterion: Stop when a minute has passed and show the sheet.
levels.safety_requirements: This is a fast study, not a finished portrait. Use an object or a person who agreed to sit.

safety_notes: This is a fast study, not a finished portrait. Use an object or a person who agreed to sit.

name: Shade by changing pencil pressure
description: On a second gesture drawing, press lightly on the lit side and harder where the shadow is.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Shade by changing pencil pressure.

levels.name: Find the light
levels.completion_criterion: Point to the bright side and the dark side of the object.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not look at the sun to find the light. A lamp or a window is enough.

levels.name: Press to match
levels.completion_criterion: Use a light pressure on the bright side and a heavier pressure in the shadow.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not look at the sun to find the light. A lamp or a window is enough.

levels.name: Leave a gradient
levels.completion_criterion: Show one place where the tone changes gradually, not as a hard stripe.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not look at the sun to find the light. A lamp or a window is enough.

safety_notes: Do not look at the sun to find the light. A lamp or a window is enough.

name: Draw a contour without redrawing the line
description: Draw the outline in one continuous line and do not go back over it.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Draw a contour without redrawing the line.

levels.name: Start the line
levels.completion_criterion: Put the pencil where the outline begins and keep moving.
levels.safety_requirements: A repeated line is a different mark. Stop rather than scrubbing the same edge.

levels.name: Leave it single
levels.completion_criterion: When you are tempted to darken a bit, leave that bit as one line.
levels.safety_requirements: A repeated line is a different mark. Stop rather than scrubbing the same edge.

levels.name: Show the sheet
levels.completion_criterion: Show an outline that is one pass, not a fuzzy bundle of repeats.
levels.safety_requirements: A repeated line is a different mark. Stop rather than scrubbing the same edge.

safety_notes: A repeated line is a different mark. Stop rather than scrubbing the same edge.

name: Hatch a shadow with lines that do not cross
description: Fill a shadow with separate parallel lines. Closer lines make it darker. They do not cross.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Hatch a shadow with lines that do not cross.

levels.name: Draw the outline first
levels.completion_criterion: Make a simple outline of the object.
levels.safety_requirements: Crossing the lines is the next technique, not this one.

levels.name: Lay parallel lines
levels.completion_criterion: Fill the shadow with lines that stay apart and share one direction.
levels.safety_requirements: Crossing the lines is the next technique, not this one.

levels.name: Darken by spacing
levels.completion_criterion: Make one area darker by placing lines closer, not by crossing them.
levels.safety_requirements: Crossing the lines is the next technique, not this one.

safety_notes: Crossing the lines is the next technique, not this one.

name: Crosshatch a form and lift one highlight
description: Lay a second set of lines across the first so a round form darkens, then erase one highlight.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Crosshatch a form and lift one highlight.

levels.name: Add the crossing layer
levels.completion_criterion: Draw a second set of lines across the hatch, on the darker side.
levels.safety_requirements: Erase only the highlight. Do not rub the whole drawing out.

levels.name: Follow the form
levels.completion_criterion: Let the direction of the lines turn with the object, as around a round fruit.
levels.safety_requirements: Erase only the highlight. Do not rub the whole drawing out.

levels.name: Lift one light
levels.completion_criterion: Erase a small patch where the light hits, and leave the rest.
levels.safety_requirements: Erase only the highlight. Do not rub the whole drawing out.

safety_notes: Erase only the highlight. Do not rub the whole drawing out.

name: Draw a blind contour while looking at the object
description: Look at the object, not the paper, and let the pencil follow the edge.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Draw a blind contour while looking at the object.

levels.name: Look away from the page
levels.completion_criterion: Set your eyes on the object or a sculpture you may study.
levels.safety_requirements: The Tate session uses sculpture in a gallery. At home, use an object you may look at. Do not copy a copyrighted image.

levels.name: Follow one edge
levels.completion_criterion: Move the pencil as your eye moves along one edge, without checking the page.
levels.safety_requirements: The Tate session uses sculpture in a gallery. At home, use an object you may look at. Do not copy a copyrighted image.

levels.name: Then look
levels.completion_criterion: Look at the drawing only after the line is done, and name one proportion that went astray.
levels.safety_requirements: The Tate session uses sculpture in a gallery. At home, use an object you may look at. Do not copy a copyrighted image.

safety_notes: The Tate session uses sculpture in a gallery. At home, use an object you may look at. Do not copy a copyrighted image.

name: Compare an HB mark with a 6B mark
description: Make one patch with an HB pencil and one with a 6B, and say which is darker and which is harder.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Compare an HB mark with a 6B mark.

levels.name: Label the pencils
levels.completion_criterion: If you have both grades, write HB and 6B beside two boxes. If you have only one, say so and stop.
levels.safety_requirements: The Tate workshop names this comparison. Do not claim a grade you do not have in your hand.

levels.name: Fill two patches
levels.completion_criterion: Fill each box with that pencil, using a similar pressure.
levels.safety_requirements: The Tate workshop names this comparison. Do not claim a grade you do not have in your hand.

levels.name: Say the difference
levels.completion_criterion: Say which patch is darker and which point feels harder.
levels.safety_requirements: The Tate workshop names this comparison. Do not claim a grade you do not have in your hand.

safety_notes: The Tate workshop names this comparison. Do not claim a grade you do not have in your hand.

name: Stipple a tone with dots
description: Build a dark patch from dots, and keep the dots from turning into lines.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Stipple a tone with dots.

levels.name: Dot the light area
levels.completion_criterion: Place dots far apart on the lighter side.
levels.safety_requirements: Stippling is slow. A small patch is enough.

levels.name: Crowd the dark area
levels.completion_criterion: Place dots closer where the object is darker.
levels.safety_requirements: Stippling is slow. A small patch is enough.

levels.name: Check for lines
levels.completion_criterion: Look for a place where dots joined into a line, and stop or separate them.
levels.safety_requirements: Stippling is slow. A small patch is enough.

safety_notes: Stippling is slow. A small patch is enough.

name: Choose hatching or crosshatching for one shadow
description: Look at one shadow and say whether separate lines or crossed lines will darken it, then do only that.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Choose hatching or crosshatching for one shadow.

levels.name: Point to the shadow
levels.completion_criterion: Point to one shadow on the object or the sculpture.
levels.safety_requirements: The Tate session asks when to use each. This is that choice, not a second copy of both techniques.

levels.name: Choose
levels.completion_criterion: Say hatching if a single direction is enough, or crosshatching if you need it darker.
levels.safety_requirements: The Tate session asks when to use each. This is that choice, not a second copy of both techniques.

levels.name: Use only that
levels.completion_criterion: Make the mark you named and do not add the other in that patch.
levels.safety_requirements: The Tate session asks when to use each. This is that choice, not a second copy of both techniques.

safety_notes: The Tate session asks when to use each. This is that choice, not a second copy of both techniques.

name: Introduce yourself and someone with you
description: In a language you are learning, say who you are and who is with you, using phrases you can actually say.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Introduce yourself and someone with you.

levels.name: Say your name
levels.completion_criterion: Say your name and one phrase for hello.
levels.safety_requirements: One language is enough. Do not invent a meaning. The CEFR A1 scale describes this kind of introduction; the levels here are an editorial practice, not a copied exam.

levels.name: Name the other person
levels.completion_criterion: Say the other person's name as they have agreed you may say it.
levels.safety_requirements: One language is enough. Do not invent a meaning. The CEFR A1 scale describes this kind of introduction; the levels here are an editorial practice, not a copied exam.

levels.name: Stop for help
levels.completion_criterion: If you lose the phrase, ask the other speaker to slow down, and stop.
levels.safety_requirements: One language is enough. Do not invent a meaning. The CEFR A1 scale describes this kind of introduction; the levels here are an editorial practice, not a copied exam.

safety_notes: One language is enough. Do not invent a meaning. The CEFR A1 scale describes this kind of introduction; the levels here are an editorial practice, not a copied exam.

name: Ask where someone lives and answer for yourself
description: Ask a simple where-question and answer it for yourself with a place you can name.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Ask where someone lives and answer for yourself.

levels.name: Ask
levels.completion_criterion: Ask where the person lives, slowly, in the language you are learning.
levels.safety_requirements: Personal details stay with people who agreed to the practice. Do not collect a stranger's address.

levels.name: Answer
levels.completion_criterion: Say where you live, in a short phrase.
levels.safety_requirements: Personal details stay with people who agreed to the practice. Do not collect a stranger's address.

levels.name: Repair
levels.completion_criterion: If they do not understand, repeat once more slowly, then stop.
levels.safety_requirements: Personal details stay with people who agreed to the practice. Do not collect a stranger's address.

name: Follow one slow instruction in the language you are learning

levels.name: Listen once
levels.completion_criterion: Have someone say one short instruction, slowly.
levels.safety_requirements: The A1 description says the other person may need to help. Guessing the action is not success.

levels.name: Do it
levels.completion_criterion: Do the action if you understood it.
levels.safety_requirements: The A1 description says the other person may need to help. Guessing the action is not success.

levels.name: Ask for a repeat
levels.completion_criterion: If you did not, ask them to say it again, and do it only then.
levels.safety_requirements: The A1 description says the other person may need to help. Guessing the action is not success.

name: Find a familiar word on a simple notice

levels.name: Pick a short text

levels.name: Point to one word
levels.completion_criterion: Point to a word you recognise.
levels.safety_requirements: A1 reading is familiar words and very simple sentences. Do not translate the whole poster.

levels.name: Say the limit

name: End an exchange when you cannot continue it

levels.name: Start

levels.name: Add one fact
levels.completion_criterion: Give one more simple fact, such as a time or a place.
levels.safety_requirements: A2 includes short exchanges you may not be able to sustain. Stopping is the skill, not pretending fluency.

levels.name: Stop honestly
levels.completion_criterion: When you cannot go on, say so, in either language, and stop.

name: Describe where you live in a few simple sentences

levels.name: Name the place
levels.completion_criterion: Say the town or the kind of home.
levels.safety_requirements: This matches the A2 idea of describing your immediate environment. Do not read a memorised paragraph you cannot vary.

levels.name: Add one detail
levels.completion_criterion: Add one concrete detail, such as a shop, a station, or a garden.
levels.safety_requirements: This matches the A2 idea of describing your immediate environment. Do not read a memorised paragraph you cannot vary.

levels.name: Link them
levels.completion_criterion: Join the two sentences with a simple and or but, and stop.

name: Find one predictable fact in a menu or a timetable

levels.name: Choose the fact

levels.safety_requirements: A2 reading includes predictable information in menus and timetables. Do not claim the whole document.

levels.safety_requirements: A2 reading includes predictable information in menus and timetables. Do not claim the whole document.

levels.name: Read it

name: Take a soil sample from below the surface
description: Take the pinch from about 15 centimetres down, not from the loose surface, then put the hole back.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Take a soil sample from below the surface.

levels.name: Clear the surface
levels.completion_criterion: Move leaves aside and dig a small hole about a hand's depth.
levels.safety_requirements: The RHS school page says about 15 cm. Do not take soil from a protected site or someone else's garden without permission.

levels.name: Take the pinch
levels.completion_criterion: Take a small sample from that depth and put it in a clean container.
levels.safety_requirements: The RHS school page says about 15 cm. Do not take soil from a protected site or someone else's garden without permission.

levels.name: Close the hole
levels.completion_criterion: Put the soil back and wash your hands.
levels.safety_requirements: The RHS school page says about 15 cm. Do not take soil from a protected site or someone else's garden without permission.

safety_notes: The RHS school page says about 15 cm. Do not take soil from a protected site or someone else's garden without permission.

name: Tell a sticky soil from a gritty one
description: Wet two samples and say which sticks to your fingers more. Clay sticks more than sand.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Tell a sticky soil from a gritty one.

levels.name: Wet both
levels.completion_criterion: Add a little water to two labelled samples.
levels.safety_requirements: This is the RHS classroom contrast, not a full texture class and not a fertilizer plan.

levels.name: Rub them
levels.completion_criterion: Rub each between finger and thumb.
levels.safety_requirements: This is the RHS classroom contrast, not a full texture class and not a fertilizer plan.

levels.name: Name the stickier
levels.completion_criterion: Say which one sticks more, and call that the clayier sample. Wash your hands.
levels.safety_requirements: This is the RHS classroom contrast, not a full texture class and not a fertilizer plan.

safety_notes: This is the RHS classroom contrast, not a full texture class and not a fertilizer plan.

name: Roll a moist soil sample into a ball
description: Wet about a spoonful until crumbs break down, then see whether it will form a ball.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Roll a moist soil sample into a ball.

levels.name: Wet it slowly
levels.completion_criterion: Add water a little at a time and knead until crumbs break.
levels.safety_requirements: The AHDB hand method starts here. A laboratory result is a different claim. Wash your hands.

levels.name: Try the ball
levels.completion_criterion: Press it into a ball. If it falls apart, say so.
levels.safety_requirements: The AHDB hand method starts here. A laboratory result is a different claim. Wash your hands.

levels.name: Stop before a class list
levels.completion_criterion: Say only whether it held a ball. Do not announce a percentage of clay.
levels.safety_requirements: The AHDB hand method starts here. A laboratory result is a different claim. Wash your hands.

safety_notes: The AHDB hand method starts here. A laboratory result is a different claim. Wash your hands.

name: Stop a hand texture test when the feel is unclear
description: Work through the feel only as far as you can answer, and say the test is not a lab result.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Stop a hand texture test when the feel is unclear.

levels.name: Answer the first question
levels.completion_criterion: Say whether the moist sample is mostly rough and gritty.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not invent a texture class to finish the flowchart. AHDB says the hand test is an indication.

levels.name: Stop at the doubt
levels.completion_criterion: When you cannot tell sticky from silky, stop and write 'unclear'.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not invent a texture class to finish the flowchart. AHDB says the hand test is an indication.

levels.name: Name the limit
levels.completion_criterion: Say that a percentage, or a map class, would need a lab or a soil map, not this pinch.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not invent a texture class to finish the flowchart. AHDB says the hand test is an indication.

safety_notes: Do not invent a texture class to finish the flowchart. AHDB says the hand test is an indication.

name: Check that a bar chart starts at zero
description: Look at a bar chart and say whether the value axis starts at zero. If it does not, the bar lengths are not a fair comparison.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Check that a bar chart starts at zero.

levels.name: Find the axis
levels.completion_criterion: Point to the axis that carries the numbers.
levels.safety_requirements: The ONS service manual says a bar axis should start at zero. Do not redraw official statistics as if you were the publisher.

levels.name: Read the start
levels.completion_criterion: Read the first number. Say whether it is zero.
levels.safety_requirements: The ONS service manual says a bar axis should start at zero. Do not redraw official statistics as if you were the publisher.

levels.name: Say what that means
levels.completion_criterion: If it is not zero, say the longest bar may look more different than the numbers are.
levels.safety_requirements: The ONS service manual says a bar axis should start at zero. Do not redraw official statistics as if you were the publisher.

safety_notes: The ONS service manual says a bar axis should start at zero. Do not redraw official statistics as if you were the publisher.

name: Match bars or columns to the comparison
description: Use bars for categories. For time, use columns. Say so before you draw three values.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Match bars or columns to the comparison.

levels.name: Say what varies
levels.completion_criterion: Say whether you are comparing categories or moments in time.
levels.safety_requirements: This follows the ONS distinction. It is not a full publication chart.

levels.name: Pick the form
levels.completion_criterion: Choose horizontal bars for categories, or vertical columns for time.
levels.safety_requirements: This follows the ONS distinction. It is not a full publication chart.

levels.name: Draw three
levels.completion_criterion: Draw three bars or columns from zero and label them.
levels.safety_requirements: This follows the ONS distinction. It is not a full publication chart.

safety_notes: This follows the ONS distinction. It is not a full publication chart.

name: Order category bars from largest to smallest
description: When the categories have no other order, sort the bars from the largest value to the smallest.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Order category bars from largest to smallest.

levels.name: List three values
levels.completion_criterion: Write three categories and the numbers you counted or were given.
levels.safety_requirements: If the categories are a time sequence, do not sort them by size. The ONS page says time is a different case.

levels.name: Sort them
levels.completion_criterion: Put the largest value first and the smallest last.
levels.safety_requirements: If the categories are a time sequence, do not sort them by size. The ONS page says time is a different case.

levels.name: Draw them from zero
levels.completion_criterion: Draw the bars in that order, with the axis starting at zero.
levels.safety_requirements: If the categories are a time sequence, do not sort them by size. The ONS page says time is a different case.

safety_notes: If the categories are a time sequence, do not sort them by size. The ONS page says time is a different case.

name: Read one bar as a length from zero
description: Read one bar by its length from zero, and say the value the gridline or the label gives.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Read one bar as a length from zero.

levels.name: Pick one bar
levels.completion_criterion: Point to one bar and name its category.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not infer a cause from two bars. Reading the length is the skill.

levels.name: Read the value
levels.completion_criterion: Read the number at its end, using the axis.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not infer a cause from two bars. Reading the length is the skill.

levels.name: Compare once
levels.completion_criterion: Say whether it is longer or shorter than one other bar, and stop.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not infer a cause from two bars. Reading the length is the skill.

safety_notes: Do not infer a cause from two bars. Reading the length is the skill.

name: Warm up before someone is ready to listen

emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Warm up before someone is ready to listen.

levels.name: Arrive with time
levels.completion_criterion: Arrive early enough to get the music out and settle.
levels.safety_requirements: The ABRSM candidate guide describes this arrival and warm-up. It is not an exam entry. Keep the volume modest.

levels.name: Warm up quietly
levels.completion_criterion: If people can hear the performance room, warm up without playing aloud, or use a room set aside for it.
levels.safety_requirements: The ABRSM candidate guide describes this arrival and warm-up. It is not an exam entry. Keep the volume modest.

levels.name: Play a few notes
levels.completion_criterion: Once it is your turn, play or sing a few notes before the piece.
levels.safety_requirements: The ABRSM candidate guide describes this arrival and warm-up. It is not an exam entry. Keep the volume modest.

safety_notes: The ABRSM candidate guide describes this arrival and warm-up. It is not an exam entry. Keep the volume modest.

name: Tune to a reference as the last check

levels.name: Tune beforehand
levels.completion_criterion: Tune as far as you can before you enter.
levels.safety_requirements: Matching one string to a note is a smaller skill you may already have. This is the check immediately before playing with someone. Do not force a peg.

levels.name: Match the reference
levels.completion_criterion: Play the reference note and bring your note to it.
levels.safety_requirements: Matching one string to a note is a smaller skill you may already have. This is the check immediately before playing with someone. Do not force a peg.

levels.name: Ask if you cannot

levels.safety_requirements: Matching one string to a note is a smaller skill you may already have. This is the check immediately before playing with someone. Do not force a peg.

levels.safety_requirements: The guide gives about half a minute and says nothing in that look is assessed. At home, the look is still the skill. Do not claim an exam mark.
